Constructors
Problem Statement:
Write a program that demonstrates the use of parameterized constructors by creating a class representing a rectangle and calculating its area.

Description:
The program should have a Rectangle class with a parameterized constructor to initialize the length and width. The class should have a method to calculate the area of the rectangle.

Input Format:

Two integers representing the length and width of the rectangle.
Output Format:

The area of the rectangle.
input_spec: Two integers representing the length and width of the rectangle.
